featured_reviews.name: Alpesh Vadatkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an extremely horrible and unsafe experience at this restaurant.

My friend and I visited to have Chinese food, and after finishing our meal, he suddenly had a swallowing issue and urgently tried to drink water from the bottle kept on the table. Unfortunately, in that moment of panic, he didn’t realize that the bottle placed there was not water—but vinegar.

This is absolutely unacceptable. Who in their right mind keeps a vinegar bottle on the table in a way that looks exactly like a water bottle? This is not just careless—it’s dangerous.

When I questioned the staff about this, instead of apologizing or taking responsibility, they responded with complete arrogance. The staff bluntly said, “You should have read before drinking,” which is a ridiculous thing to say in an emergency situation. There was zero empathy, zero accountability.

To make matters worse, the owner got involved and started arguing aggressively instead of resolving the issue. He kept justifying that they place “sauce bottles” on the table—but that was simply not true. Only the vinegar bottle was kept, and it was misleading enough to cause this situation.

The behavior of both the staff and the owner was extremely rude, disrespectful, and unprofessional. Not only do they lack basic customer service skills, but they also show no concern for customer safety.

I would strongly advise everyone to avoid this place. There are far better and safer options nearby. I regret choosing this restaurant just because the neighboring one was crowded.

Absolutely not recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Ankit Vishwakarma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very bad experience at Hot Plate Fast Food. I ordered Manchurian rice with gravy, but the food was completely unacceptable.

First of all, the rice smelled very bad, like it was old or spoiled. It felt as if the rice had been stored for days and then reused. The taste was terrible — honestly, I’ve had much better food even from roadside stalls.

Secondly, I ordered Manchurian rice, but there was not even a single proper Manchurian piece in it. The Manchurian balls in the gravy were undercooked and tasted raw (you can clearly see it in the image).

Also, while I was there, I saw other customers complaining:
Someone ordered a cheese frankie but didn’t get any cheese.
Another person got a burger that was completely cold, like it was taken straight out of the fridge and served without heating.
The overall food quality, hygiene, and service are extremely poor. This place seriously needs to improve its standards.

Worst fried rice I have ever had. I would not recommend this place to anyone.

featured_reviews.name: Crystal Dsa
featured_reviews.review_text:
Spicy Dragon: A Culinary Gem for Chinese Food Lovers
Spicy Dragon in Bhayandar East is a Chinese restaurant that truly lives up to its name, offering authentic and flavorful spicy dishes that will tantalize your taste buds. The restaurant has a warm and inviting atmosphere, blending traditional Chinese décor with modern touches, making it a comfortable place to enjoy a meal. The staff are friendly and attentive, providing excellent service that enhances the dining experience.
Among the many delicious options, the Prawns Tempura, Fish Burnt Coriander, and Prawns Momos stand out as exceptional choices. The Prawns Momos, in particular, have received rave reviews for their unique and delicious flavor, with many diners praising their "awsm taste." The Fish Burnt Coriander is described as absolutely delicious and flavorful, though some note it may be too spicy for those sensitive to heat.
Overall, Spicy Dragon is a must-visit for anyone craving authentic Chinese cuisine in Mira Bhayandar. The combination of flavorful dishes, a pleasant atmosphere, and excellent service makes it a truly memorable dining experience.

featured_reviews.review_text: I think I have went here more than I should. You can't go wrong with this. All the dishes I've ordered here were great (except the bao). Also the deserts are good. I'd recommend the one desert which have dates on it.

featured_reviews.name: Suraj Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this authentic Chinese restaurant in Mira Road, and I must say, it was an absolute delight! The food was incredibly delicious—exactly what I had been searching for. Every dish was packed with authentic flavors, making it a truly satisfying experience.

The staff was exceptionally polite, friendly, and professional, making us feel as if we were dining in a five-star restaurant. My family thoroughly enjoyed the experience, and the warm hospitality added to the charm.

What truly impressed me was the presence of world-class chefs in this small town. Their expertise shines through in every bite.

Beyond the food, the restaurant’s ambience was calming, simple, and inviting—perfect for a relaxed dining experience.

And the ultimate seal of approval? My 10-year-old, who has a great taste for food, gave it a big thumbs-up! That alone speaks volumes.

Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Khushi Bajaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
The place in this heat didn't felt well ventilated. We had to ask them to turn on the fan above our table, while it was turned on for another table of content creators without them asking for it.
Other than this, service wise they're quick and efficient.

We had 4 dishes in total totaling upto 1400/-
Yakitori - 3/5 : It was too sweet for my taste, though my friend enjoyed it.
Japanese Gyoza - 4.5/5 : It was a flavor bomb! Well seasoned and cooked. I throughly enjoyed it.
Spicy Ramen - 2.5/5 : The plating didn't make it feel tempting, there was a big slab of paneer which was not seasoned properly. It wasn't that spicy, so probably non-spicy eaters can handle it. Other than that, it was just okay.
Smoky spicy momos - 2.5/5 : The filling was just not it. The seasoning felt off, it didn't tasted good to me. Otherwise, it was cooked well and tossed in schezwan sauce properly.

So overall our experience was average at the end of the day.

We were hungry so we forgot to click pictures of first 2 dishes 🥲

featured_reviews.name: Sakshi Choudhary
featured_reviews.review_text: We ordered the crispy chicken bao, chicken yakitori, and miso ramen. The chicken yakitori and crispy chicken bao were delicious and really well made. However, the miso ramen had a coconut-based broth, which was unexpected and not to my taste, so I’d recommend skipping it. Apart from that, the other dishes were really good. You can definitely try this place.

featured_reviews.name: Bryan John
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited this place and absolutely loved the ambience it’s such a charming spot. The Chicken Crunchy Sushi was delicious, but the highlight was definitely the Veg Miso Ramen. The noodles were perfectly cooked, and the paneer literally melted in the mouth. Highly recommended ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Bikas Gurung
featured_reviews.review_text:
Oeshi is easily one of the best Pan-Asian restaurants in Mira Road.
We tried:
Chicken Crunchy Sushi – ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Cheese Avocado Sushi – ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Chicken Miso Ramen – ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Chicken Thai Green Curry – ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
The best was Chicken Kung Pao Bao.
Every dish was a perfect 10/10. The ambience and service were top-notch, and the in-house music really elevates the dining experience.
Highly recommended for Pan-Asian food lovers in Mira Road! 🍣🍜🎶

featured_reviews.name: Deep Kakade
featured_reviews.review_text: Went to OESHI with cousins. Amazing food. Manchaow soup was simply simple and perfect. We ordered spinich and cottage cheese dimsums, trust me they were more brilliant than amazing chicken dimsum. Chicken momos were also too good specially with the chutteny. Veg hakka noodles were truly exotic. We finished with tripple rice at the end. But overall food was satisfying both stomach and heart through tongue and mind! Great owner and hosting. Cutlery was superb. Besides paper glasses 😅. But what you can do agar customer he piche pade.

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Raut
featured_reviews.review_text: Been customer since it was known as sizzling caidan! One of the best restaurants for asian cuisine! Tasty food for very affordable rates! Service can take time sometimes so plan accordingly! Tom kha gai soup, burnese prawns noodles, crispy chicken bao, jamaican jerk chicken are super recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Ranaja Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
Where do I even begin…
The dishes we tried were absolutely mind-blowing!

We started with chicken hot and sour soup, sushi, momos, and dumplings. The chicken hot and sour soup was truly outstanding—easily one of the best I’ve ever had. A solid 100/10!
It was my first visit, and it was completely worth it.

Definitely planning to go back very soon!

featured_reviews.name: Prachi Hakim
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Oeshi for Sunday dinner. This restaurant is almost at the end of the earth 😉 (check the satellite view on maps and you'll know why I say so!) and so I thought it must be untouched yet. But it was quite crowded.
Ambiance is fine. Its not very small place but with reasonable number of tables.
Service is super slow and this is the only area where they need improvement in. Although the staff was cooperative and well spoken and trying their best to serve everyone, the dishes took very long time.l to reach the table. However, when the food actually arrived, it was worth the wait.
Dishes tried:
Tenthuk Momo soup: It was comforting, flavorful and had so many textures. Loved it! 5/5
Chicken crispy Sushi: Very well made. 4.5/5.
Chicken dimsums: The stuffing was flavorful, but the covering had some smell or maybe dint suit my palate. 3/5
Basil spicy Noodles: Perfectly cooked and spiced. 4/5
Crispy chicken Bao: My husband had Bao for first time. But he loved it. 4.5/5
After eating all of that, we still wanted to eat more Sushi, so we ordered Barbecue Sushi (don't remember exact name) which was little spicy but super tasty. 4.5/5

We will definitely visit again. Hope to aee improved service time next time! 🤞

featured_reviews.name: Harry Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Hidden Gem for Chinese Street Food Lovers!

Absolutely blown away by the flavors at this Chinese street food spot! Every bite was packed with authentic spices and bold taste — just like the street stalls in Beijing or Shanghai. The noodles were freshly tossed with smoky wok hei, the momos were juicy and bursting with filling, and the chili oil? Next-level!

The service was fast, and the food came out piping hot. It’s casual, no-frills, and exactly what street food should be — quick, flavorful, and affordable. If you’re craving real Chinese flavors without the fancy setup, this place is a must-try. I’m already planning my next visit
